audit_item: A10 / normalize excessive nesting in contract JSON readers
finding: Canonical DTO decoding and CLI error-envelope parsing called json.loads directly and leaked RecursionError for sufficiently deep JSON payloads. Canonical DTO conversion could also recurse after parsing succeeded.
change: Both contracts readers convert decoder RecursionError into stable ValueError messages. Canonical DTO decoding also normalizes recursion from nested DTO conversion and canonical re-encoding.
